archetypes.name: dyn-heartbeat-concurrency
archetypes.rationale: Change adds a daemon heartbeat thread around a long blocking call; needs thread-lifecycle and stream-interleaving scrutiny
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new heartbeat thread in checks_repair_loop_main and the _emit_repair_loop_heartbeat helper in python/checks.py. Verify the daemon thread is always stopped and joined on every exit path (success return, the OSError branch, and any exception), that the stop Event signaling plus the bounded join timeout cannot deadlock or leak the worker thread, and that heartbeat writes to sys.stderr from the worker thread cannot corrupt or interleave with the stdout NEXT_ACTION/LOOP_STATUS grammar the orchestrator parses. Confirm no heartbeat line can be emitted after run_check_fix_loop returns, and that the shared run_check_fix_loop caller at run_checks_phase is unaffected. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
